CustomField.label: SLA Status
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(Priority), "Low", IF(Case_Age_Hours__c <= 72, "Within SLA", IF(Case_Age_Hours__c <= 86.4, "Approaching SLA", "SLA Breached")), "Medium", IF(Case_Age_Hours__c <= 48, "Within SLA", IF(Case_Age_Hours__c <= 57.6, "Approaching SLA", "SLA Breached")), "High", IF(Case_Age_Hours__c <= 24, "Within SLA", IF(Case_Age_Hours__c <= 28.8, "Approaching SLA", "SLA Breached")), "Critical", IF(Case_Age_Hours__c <= 8, "Within SLA", IF(Case_Age_Hours__c <= 9.6, "Approaching SLA", "SLA Breached")), "Within SLA")
